title: PH60407: Pattern Forming Instabilities
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Linear stability of spatially uniform state: Rayleigh-Benard convection,
Couette-Taylor flow, Faraday crispations. Classification of Linear
instabilities: stationary, oscillatory, structural instabilities with simple
examples, Nonlinear patterns in spatially extended systems: Amplitude
equations, method of multiple scales, Floquet theory, phenomenological models,
Galerkin models, Eckhouse instability, competing patterns, Dynamics of
dislocations
